name: SET_DRIVER_SEAT_HEATING_STATE
unavailable: 65535 (0xFFFF: stock hasFeature/BYDAutoSafetyBeltDevice treat it as link error / no signal)
note: Three-level path. DiCarServer picks it when the AC_*_SEAT_*_CONFIG for the seat reads 3 (all four read 3 on 2026-10-20); the 5-level AC_* path read 0 (neither 1 on nor 2 off) so it is inactive here. Stock reader maps 4/3/2 to level 3/2/1 and anything else to off (-100); the voice app shows raw-1. The stock setter writes 6 (not 4) for driver heating level 3 (VentHeatValues.MAIN_DRIVER_LEVEL_3_SET, lines 34, 292-294); the reader does not map 6, so whether the feedback reports 4 or 6 at level 3 must be checked live.
